name: svg-french-press-nemotron-3.5-super-vl-s1-r3
prompt: Draw an exploded assembly diagram of a French press, as an SVG. Use the standard three-piece plunger filter rather than a two-piece travel press.

source.text:
<svg width="620" height="1150" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <defs>
    <style>
      .carafe   { fill: #d9edf3; stroke: #4a7c8c; stroke-width: 2; }
      .metal    { fill: #c9c9c9; stroke: #555; stroke-width: 2; }
      .rod      { fill: none; stroke: #666; stroke-width: 10; stroke-linecap: round; }
      .mesh     { fill: #e8e8e8; stroke: #555; stroke-width: 2; }
      .label    { font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; fill: #1a1a1a; }
      .label-sm { font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 13; fill: #1a1a1a; }
      .title    { font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 24; font-weight: bold; fill: #1a1a1a; }
      .subtitle { font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 13; fill: #555; }
      .leader   { stroke: #888; stroke-width: 1.5; fill: none; }
      .axis     { stroke: #999; stroke-width: 1.5; stroke-dasharray: 7,5; fill: none; }
      .num      { font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 14; font-weight: bold; fill: #fff; }
    </style>
    <mesh id="meshPattern" width="18" height="18">
      <rect width="18" height="18" fill="none"/>
      <path d="M 0 9 L 18 9 M 9 0 L 9 18" stroke="#888" stroke-width="1.3"/>
    </mesh>
  </defs>

  <rect width="620" height="1150" fill="#f7f7f7"/>

  <text x="310" y="46" text-anchor="middle" class="title">French Press — Exploded Assembly</text>
  <text x="310" y="72" text-anchor="middle" class="subtitle">Standard three-piece plunger filter: upper cross plate • mesh filter • lower support plate</text>

  <!-- Central assembly axis -->
  <line x1="310" y1="100" x2="310" y2="900" class="axis"/>

  <!-- ===== 1. KNOB / HANDLE ===== -->
  <g transform="translate(310,150)">
    <circle r="26" class="metal"/>
    <circle r="10" fill="#999" stroke="#444" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  </g>
  <line x1="310" y1="176" x2="310" y2="262" class="rod"/>

  <!-- ===== 3. UPPER CROSS PLATE ===== -->
  <g transform="translate(310,360)">
    <circle r="80" class="metal"/>
    <circle r="80" fill="none" stroke="#777" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="4,4"/>
    <line x1="-62" y1="0" x2="62" y2="0" stroke="#777" stroke-width="3"/>
    <line x1="0" y1="-62" x2="0" y2="62" stroke="#777" stroke-width="3"/>
    <circle r="14" fill="none" stroke="#777" stroke-width="2"/>
  </g>

  <!-- ===== 4. MESH FILTER ===== -->
  <g transform="translate(310,510)">
    <circle r="80" class="mesh"/>
    <rect x="-80" y="-80" width="160" height="160" fill="url(#meshPattern)" opacity="0.9"/>
    <circle r="80" fill="none" stroke="#777" stroke-width="1"/>
  </g>

  <!-- ===== 5. LOWER SUPPORT PLATE ===== -->
  <g transform="translate(310,660)">
    <circle r="80" class="metal"/>
    <circle r="80" fill="none" stroke="#777" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="4,4"/>
    <circle r="20" fill="#b3b3b3"/>
  </g>

  <!-- ===== 6. COIL SPRING ===== -->
  <g transform="translate(310,770)">
    <path d="M -58 0 Q -45 10 -32 0 Q -19 10 -6 0 Q 7 10 20 0 Q 33 10 46 0 Q 59 10 58 0" 
          fill="none" stroke="#7a5a3a" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="-60" y1="0" x2="60" y2="0" stroke="#7a5a3a" stroke-width="2"/>
  </g>

  <!-- ===== 7. LID CAP (sits on carafe) ===== -->
  <g transform="translate(310,870)">
    <circle r="80" class="metal"/>
    <circle r="80" fill="none" stroke="#777" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="4,4"/>
    <circle r="18" fill="none" stroke="#777" stroke-width="2"/>
    <path d="M -80 0 L 80 0" stroke="#777" stroke-width="1" opacity="0.6"/>
  </g>

  <!-- ===== 8. GLASS CARAFE ===== -->
  <g transform="translate(310,950)">
    <!-- body -->
    <path d="M -90 0 L -90 130 C -90 150 -55 162 0 162 C 55 162 90 150 90 130 L 90 0 C 90 -18 60 -28 0 -28 C -60 -28 -90 -18 -90 0 Z" class="carafe"/>
    <!-- rim -->
    <ellipse cx="0" cy="0" rx="90" ry="16" fill="none" stroke="#4a7c8c" stroke-width="2.5"/>
    <!-- handle -->
    <path d="M 90 -14 Q 132 -14 148 22 Q 154 92 106 92" fill="none" stroke="#4a7c8c" stroke-width="10" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <!-- spout -->
    <path d="M -90 0 Q -108 0 -116 32 Q -100 48 -88 28" fill="none" stroke="#4a7c8c" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  </g>

  <!-- ===== LEADER LINES (right side) ===== -->
  <g class="leader">
    <line x1="390" y1="150" x2="440" y2="150"/>
    <line x1="390" y1="262" x2="440" y2="262"/>
    <line x1="390" y1="360" x2="440" y2="360"/>
    <line x1="390" y1="510" x2="440" y2="510"/>
    <line x1="390" y1="660" x2="440" y2="660"/>
    <line x1="390" y1="770" x2="440" y2="770"/>
    <line x1="390" y1="870" x2="440" y2="870"/>
    <line x1="220" y1="1030" x2="175" y2="1030"/>
  </g>

  <text x="445" y="154" class="label-sm">1 · Plunger knob (handle)</text>
  <text x="445" y="266" class="label-sm">2 · Plunger rod</text>
  <text x="445" y="364" class="label-sm">3 · Upper cross plate</text>
  <text x="445" y="514" class="label-sm">4 · Mesh filter (fine screen)</text>
  <text x="445" y="664" class="label-sm">5 · Lower support plate</text>
  <text x="445" y="774" class="label-sm">6 · Coil spring</text>
  <text x="445" y="874" class="label-sm">7 · Lid cap</text>
  <text x="172" y="1034" class="label-sm" text-anchor="end">8 · Glass carafe</text>

  <!-- Part number badges on the axis (left of parts) -->
  <g transform="translate(254,0)">
    <circle cx="0" cy="150" r="11" fill="#1a1a1a"/><text x="0" y="154" class="num" text-anchor="middle">1</text>
    <circle cx="0" cy="262" r="11" fill="#1a1a1a"/><text x="0" y="266" class="num" text-anchor="middle">2</text>
    <circle cx="0" cy="360" r="11" fill="#1a1a1a"/><text x="0" y="364" class="num" text-anchor="middle">3</text>
    <circle cx="0" cy="510" r="11" fill="#1a1a1a"/><text x="0" y="514" class="num" text-anchor="middle">4</text>
    <circle cx="0" cy="660" r="11" fill="#1a1a1a"/><text x="0" y="664" class="num" text-anchor="middle">5</text>
    <circle cx="0" cy="770" r="11" fill="#1a1a1a"/><text x="0" y="774" class="num" text-anchor="middle">6</text>
    <circle cx="0" cy="870" r="11" fill="#1a1a1a"/><text x="0" y="874" class="num" text-anchor="middle">7</text>
  </g>
  <circle cx="254" cy="1030" r="11" fill="#1a1a1a"/><text x="254" y="1034" class="num" text-anchor="middle">8</text>

  <!-- Assembly note -->
  <text x="310" y="1115" text-anchor="middle" class="subtitle" font-size="12">Assembly order (bottom → top): spring, lower plate, mesh filter, cross plate, rod, knob.</text>
</svg>
